identification_caveat: A per-round scheduler mechanism and the per-drafting-round wired-residency state share the same basis when nearly every round is a drafting round, so the per-prompt shape alone cannot separate them. They are separated here by three readings that do not use the shape: the drama control, whose schedule pb6 provably does not move; a free fit of the coefficient itself; and the replayer's prediction of the mechanism from the width masses without seeing the receipt. R5-c inherits a second limit: the design matrix is replayed, and the transfer is fitted to one moment per prompt, the published effective mean draft length, so the width distribution around that mean is a model output and not a measurement.
